headline: Heavy Battles Shake Weathered Expanse and Island Fronts
war_summary: Since the last report, combat has intensified along the island front at Fisherman's Row, registering twelve strategic base exchanges over the past two hours centered on Black Well and Eidolo. Weathered Expanse remains in violent contest with six fresh base actions and over twenty-six hundred combined casualties in the two-hour window, focused around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Strategic shifts have resumed in Stlican Shelf, logging six base movements across Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town alongside heavy attrition. In Mooring County, fighting reopened base movement at Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast with three exchanges and over thirteen hundred casualties in two hours. Callahan's Passage maintains severe bloodshed with over thirty-eight hundred casualties in two hours, though base transitions slowed to three at The Crumbling Passage. Stema Landing sustained ongoing skirmishing with two recent base shifts leaving one position neutral, while Nevish Line settled into positional attrition with no new base changes in the latest two hours.
